patch_description: Crosses over the hypercube CZ entangling structure from the first inspiration script with the parameter sharing (collective parameters) of the current program. Instead of clumping all CZ gates into a single commuting block, this candidate interleaves collective `RY`, `RX`, and `RZ` rotation layers between the hypercube dimension connections. This prevents the CZs from commuting and massively increases the ansatz's expressivity (creating a true hardware-efficient layer), while maintaining the highly efficient parameter count (only 4 parameters per block, yielding a very high parameter efficiency score).
